$comment: AEP-0002 Annex A machine-usable mapping fixture for the Gemini CLI table (11 hooks: 8 -> core types, 3 model-plane hooks -> the vendor extension namespace BY DESIGN, plus the mechanical fallback for unknown hooks). Each entry pins the pure hook->event mapping at the adapter default capture posture (capture metadata; attention.* redacted — unused: nothing here maps to attention.*, see Notification). input uses the vendor-documented field names; expected is {type, data, subject}. Envelope identity (session_id -> AEP session; runs are ADAPTER-SYNTHESIZED per BeforeAgent/AfterAgent pair — Gemini exposes no turn id) and causal wiring are runtime state, pinned by the reference adapter smoke, not here. run.js checks the reference adapter module against these pins; run.py checks schema validity and the wire facts.

identity.$comment: Gemini exposes no turn id; the adapter synthesizes one AEP run per BeforeAgent/AfterAgent pair.

expected.$comment: cwd is gated redacted and is dropped at the default metadata ceiling
vendor reasons (exit|clear|logout|prompt_input_exit|other) collapse to the schema enum normal — the sibling adapters convention
prompt is gated redacted; the adapter synthesizes the run id here
response text is message-stream territory (AEP-0007) — deliberately not captured on the run terminal

expected.subject: write_file
expected.$comment: args ride only at capture full; the digest is always present (Gemini exposes no tool call id — pairing is adapter runtime state)

expected.subject: read_file
expected.$comment: Gemini surfaces tool errors in tool_response.error — unlike Codex this maps to tool.failed honestly; error.message is gated redacted
the model plane has no core equivalent (request/response internals fail the fleet-observer test) -> vendor namespace, model id at metadata
fires per streamed chunk — the adapter emits it at severity debug and the example settings leave it unregistered by default
documented deviation: Gemini exposes only the PRE moment (advisory, unblockable) — the sibling adapters emit at post; same fleet fact, a timing skew of seconds

expected.subject: ToolPermission
expected.$comment: NOT attention.requested: the hook is observability-only (it can neither grant nor deny), so a respond affordance would be a lie; the permission moment stays visible. message is gated redacted

fallback.$comment: Unknown future hooks land in the vendor extension namespace (AEP-0001 §6 mechanical fallback, category session), never on a core type.
